newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Maybank to release results on Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Maybank to release results on Saturday.

text.p: Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) said on Wednesday it will report its half year financial results on January 25.
In a statement, the bank said its managing director, Amirsham Abdul Aziz, will hold a news conference in conjunction with the release of the results.

Analysts have said Maybank is expected to post net profit of about 580-600 million ringgit for the half-year ended December 31, 1996, up between 23.5 to 27.7 percent from the same period a year earlier.
Maybank reported net earnings of 469.7 million ringgit at the half-year mark last year, and 1.07 billion ringgit for the year ended June 30, 1996.

Analysts polled by the Estimate Directory have forecast net profit at an average 1.26 billion ringgit for the current financial year ending June 30, 1997, giving the stock a 1.10 ringgit net earnings per share.
